description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) DUTY IS NEVER DONE (Gauntlet Task Force, 1 CP) at the end of the Fight phase — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Marine player gets the seven WP-M3a detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. The Sternguard Veteran Squad was eligible to fight this phase (setup flag was_eligible_to_fight — the fight is not under test); fight_phase_end opens for Player 1; a REAL click on the Sternguard (unengaged INFANTRY wholly within 6" of the Impulsor, able to embark) spends 1 CP; they embark within the Impulsor and leave the board.
